research_notes: The current sample's numerous durable commits also verify that state/evidence persistence can occur incrementally without rewriting a shared mutable probe file.
Append-only evidence avoids intra-run overwrite races and preserves audit history.
For normal single-owner strict probes, this is conservative but straightforward.
For later parallel probes, per-worker append-only namespaces become essential rather than merely convenient.
The same evidence discipline can therefore carry forward across research stages.
